beats.say: Hello! Many data leaks start not with bad intent but with an ordinary mistake.
Autocomplete can pick the wrong address. Look at the recipient once more before sending.

body.text: This email is going outside the organisation:

beats.say: Do not upload work files to a personal cloud or to apps your organisation has not approved.
If you made a mistake, do not hide it. Reporting fast limits the harm, hiding makes it worse.

scenes.title: An ordinary workday
scenes.intro: Several requests came in today. For each one, choose how to keep the data safe.

body.text: Hi, I will work from home tonight.
Please send the staff list (ID numbers, phones) to my personal mail: nigar.84@poctam.example

actions.label: Send the list to her personal mail
actions.feedback: Personal data left your organisation's control. A personal mailbox is not protected and can leak.

actions.label: Reply: I cannot send it to personal mail
actions.feedback: Right. Working from home goes through approved tools, such as work mail over the VPN.

body.text: Anyone with the link can download the file.

steps.say: The file was too big for email, so you found a free site.

actions.label: Copy the link and send it to the partner
actions.feedback: Whoever gets the link can open the file. Your organisation has no control over this service.

actions.label: Cancel and ask IT for the approved way
actions.feedback: Right. IT support will show you the approved way to send a large file safely.

body.text: This email is going outside the organisation:

steps.say: You are sending the salary table to Rauf. Check the address.

actions.label: Send anyway
actions.feedback: The salary table went to an outside company. That is a personal data leak.

actions.label: Cancel and check the recipient
actions.feedback: Right. Your colleague is Rauf Əlizadə, but autocomplete picked Rauf Əliyev at a partner company.

steps.say: Another email has already gone to the wrong address.

actions.label: Tell the security team now
actions.feedback: Right. The sooner you report, the better the chance to recall it and limit the harm.

actions.label: Write to the recipient: please delete it
actions.feedback: Asking is good but not enough. Tell security first, they will say what to do next.

actions.label: Tell no one
actions.feedback: A hidden mistake grows. Reporting is the professional thing to do.

body.text: "My first day!" The photo shows your badge and an internal system on screen.

cards.explain: A badge and a work screen give attackers what they need to fake a card and pick targets.

body.text: I shared the file on the internal portal with our department only.

cards.explain: An approved internal place and limited access. This is the right way to share.
In a group a password reaches many people, sometimes outsiders. Passwords are never shared.

source.text: Personal cloud folder: anyone with the link can view

cards.explain: In a personal cloud a work file leaves your organisation's control, and an open link lets anyone in.

body.text: You locked the screen when you left your desk.

cards.explain: Right. A locked screen stops anyone acting in your name.

scenes.prompt: Match each risk with the right habit.

pairs.right: No screens, badges or papers in the frame

pairs.left: An email sent to the wrong person
pairs.right: Tell the security team at once

scenes.explain: These habits prevent most careless leaks.

question.prompt: A colleague says: "This free app speeds up work, install it, do not tell IT." What do you do?

options.label: I ask IT about this or an approved alternative
options.feedback: Right. IT can check whether it is safe or give you an approved alternative.

options.label: I install it, everyone uses it
options.feedback: An unchecked app can send work data outside. "Everyone uses it" does not mean safe.

options.label: I copy the files to my personal laptop and work there
options.feedback: This is shadow IT too: the data moves to an unprotected device.

scenes.explain: Apps and devices your organisation has not approved are called shadow IT. If you need something, ask IT for an approved way.

points: Check the recipient before you send
Keep work files only in approved systems
Made a mistake? Report it at once
